name: What should I look for when choosing a window repair contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a window repair contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a window repair contractor, prioritize experience with various window types and damages, especially those common in Bay Area homes. Look for contractors who provide detailed, transparent quotes, are properly licensed and insured, and have positive local references or reviews. Excellent communication, a clear understanding of the repair process, and a commitment to quality workmanship are also key indicators of a reliable professional. Verify their service area covers your location.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with proven experience, transparent quotes, proper licensing and insurance, and positive local references. Good communication and quality workmanship are also crucial.
